notablePrerequisites:
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
You are able to cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
description:
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
